input.content: Pattern: Mutating the sole happy-path test to match a new contract hides a regression instead of surfacing it. Signature: the only passing test is edited (e.g. stub response changed from `{"ok": True}` to `{"ok": True, "applied": True}`) rather than supplemented. This is the regression signature of a backward-incompatible change — the old response shape now throws, and the edited test conceals it. Fix: keep a test proving the legacy/released response path still succeeds, and ADD cases for the new contract and negative paths rather than overwriting the existing coverage. Severity P1 when it masks a P0 compatibility break.
